answer: The deposit hall for epoch 122 lets each key lease one vault. Each key must post a 17 POA bond and recover the spiral placed in that vault. The key files a prism, the signed retrieval certificate naming that vault and spiral. The board stores one lease per vault; a second lease, a reused vault, or a prism that names the wrong spiral burns the 17 POA bond. A farm of 380 keys that can staff only twelve vault files only twelve prism, so 368 keys each burn 17 POA: 368 x 17 = 6,256 POA the attacker forfeits.
